jobs.title: Global Talent Partner (3-Month Contract)
jobs.description:
Zone \& Company Software Consulting LLC ("Zone") is the ERP\-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose\-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI\-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.



As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record\-to\-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real\-time financial intelligence.



By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

#### **About the Job:**



We're looking for an experienced Talent Partner to join our People Strategy team on an initial 3\-month contract. This is a hands\-on, full\-cycle recruiting role where you'll partner closely with hiring managers across Engineering, Product, Go\-to\-Market, and Corporate teams to attract exceptional talent in a fast\-paced, global environment.



If you're someone who loves building relationships, sourcing creatively, and delivering a best\-in\-class candidate experience, we'd love to hear from you.


#### **What you'll do**


* Own full\-cycle recruitment from kickoff through offer across multiple business functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop hiring strategies and advise on market trends.
* Source and engage passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
* Conduct recruiter screens and present thoughtful, high\-quality candidate shortlists.
* Drive an exceptional candidate experience throughout the interview process.
* Manage pipelines, interview scheduling, and recruiting data within Greenhouse.
* Collaborate with the People team to continuously improve recruiting operations and hiring processes.

#### **What you'll bring**


* 4\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in B2B SaaS, technology, or a high\-growth environment.
* Experience hiring across a variety of functions, including Engineering, Product, GTM, and G\&A.
* Strong sourcing and stakeholder management skills.
* Previous experience using Greenhouse as an applicant tracking system.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted partnerships remotely.
* A proactive, organized, and highly autonomous working style.

#### **Why join us?**


* Fully remote within the UK, Spain, or Czech Republic.
* Flexible engagement with a collaborative, global team.
* Opportunity to partner directly with senior leaders during a busy period of growth.
* A fast\-paced environment where you'll have real ownership and impact.

#### **Contract details**


* Duration: Initial 3\-month contract, with potential to extend.
* Location: Fully remote from the United Kingdom, Spain, or the Czech Republic.
* Engagement: Independent contractor.
* Hours: Full\-time preferred (approximately 40 hours/week), with 3–4 hours of overlap with U.S. business hours.

**Benefits**



At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high\-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it's the standard. We're looking for self\-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.



We ditch micro\-management for high\-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers


**Join Our Global Mission**



Zone \& Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.


**Employment Terms**


**United States**



Employment with Zone is **"At\-Will"**, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.


**Non\-US Jurisdictions**



This position is offered as a Fixed\-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

jobs.title: Talent Partner - First Opinion FTC
jobs.description:
**Talent Partner – First Opinion – 12 Months FTC**
--------------------------------------------------


**Remote \- Covering the South West Region**
--------------------------------------------



**About us**

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.  

  

We’re looking for an accomplished recruiter to partner with our UK first opinion network, identifying and engaging exceptional veterinary professionals within one of the most specialised talent markets in the profession.  

  

First Opinion recruitment requires a distinctly proactive and relationship\-led approach. Success in this role will be driven by your ability to understand specialist talent markets in depth, identify and engage individuals who may not be actively considering their next career move, and build credible relationships over the longer term.  

  

Combining headhunting, executive search principles, talent mapping and market intelligence, you’ll develop sustainable pipelines of specialist veterinary talent in multiple disciplines while partnering with senior clinical leaders to deliver both immediate and future workforce requirements.  

  

This is a fully remote, home\-based role, covering the South West of England therefore occasional travel will be required for meetings, veterinary congresses and industry events across the UK and Europe.

  

**How You’ll Make a Difference**
--------------------------------

  


You’ll take ownership of recruitment across a portfolio of specialist first opinion vacancies, acting as a trusted Talent Partner to senior clinical and commercial leaders across our network.  

  

Developing a detailed understanding of individual clinical disciplines and their respective talent markets will be central to your success. You’ll use this insight to shape recruitment strategies, advise on market conditions and provide an informed perspective on talent availability, compensation, attraction, relocation and international recruitment.  

  

A significant focus of the role will be the proactive identification and engagement of specialist veterinary talent. Through systematic market mapping, targeted search and sustained relationship management, you’ll develop networks and pipelines that extend beyond current vacancies and strengthen our long\-term ability to attract exceptional clinicians.

  

**You’ll also:**
----------------

  

* Lead sophisticated headhunting and search strategies across first opinion disciplines, using market mapping, professional networks and targeted sourcing to identify and engage high\-calibre talent across the UK and internationally
* Build and maintain meaningful long\-term relationships with specialist clinicians, developing sustainable talent pipelines and communities across priority disciplines
* Partner consultatively with senior clinical and hospital leaders, providing market intelligence and using evidence to influence recruitment strategy, compensation positioning, attraction approaches and realistic hiring expectations
* Manage complex recruitment processes from initial engagement through to appointment, including assessment, candidate management, offer negotiation, relocation and visa sponsorship where appropriate
* Represent inspiring vet care at specialist veterinary congresses, professional events and networking forums across the UK and Europe, strengthening our presence and relationships within the referral community
* Use recruitment data, talent intelligence and pipeline analysis to continuously refine recruitment strategies, strengthen direct hiring capability and reduce reliance on external agencies

**You Might Be a Great Fit If...**
----------------------------------

  


You bring significant experience of recruiting within specialist or talent\-scarce markets, together with a strong track record in headhunting and/or executive search.  

  

You are skilled at looking beyond the active candidate market: understanding where specialist talent sits, developing a comprehensive view of the market and establishing credible relationships with individuals whose career decisions may develop over an extended period.  

  

Previous veterinary recruitment experience would be advantageous but is not essential. Of greater importance is your ability to apply sophisticated search methodology, develop specialist market expertise and operate as a credible recruitment partner to senior stakeholders.

  

**You’ll bring:**
-----------------

  

* Demonstrable expertise in headhunting, executive search, talent mapping and proactive direct sourcing within niche, specialist or difficult\-to\-source markets
* Proven ability to identify and engage passive talent, establish credibility and develop long\-term relationships through extended recruitment cycles
* Strong stakeholder consulting capability, with the confidence and credibility to influence and constructively challenge senior leaders
* Highly developed candidate management, assessment, negotiation and closing skills, with a focus on delivering an exceptional candidate experience
* Strong commercial judgement and the ability to interpret market intelligence and recruitment data to shape effective talent strategies and prioritise activity
* Excellent research, communication and relationship\-building skills, combined with a proactive, resilient and highly collaborative approach
* Experience within veterinary recruitment, healthcare or another specialist professional market would be advantageous, as would exposure to international recruitment, relocation and visa sponsorship.

**How We’ll Support You**
-------------------------

  


At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing.
